question: Is proposed work adjacent to or encroaching into the right-of-way (ROW) identified and labeled on this site plan? Look for labels identifying ROW work such as sidewalk construction, ROW dedications, utility work in ROW, or other improvements within or adjacent to the ROW boundaries.
regionHint: Along the street frontages where ROW improvements are proposed
reasoning: The agent is asking whether ROW work is identified and labeled on the site plan—a drawing-element annotation check (presence of labels and their placement relative to ROW boundaries), not a measurement or document-presence task.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Proposed work adjacent to or encroaching into ROW not identified and labeled (SVC-02)
